section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants' demographics for a single study. It describes a sample of 311 individuals (195 women, 116 men) recruited from two universities in São Paulo, Brazil, with a mean age of 29.32 years and a mean self-reported BMI of 23.27 kg/m2. The majority (79.4%) identified as White, and 51.1% had college or higher education.
